title: Sparky's Sparkle Secret
markdown:
The sun peeked. Bright beams painted stripes across Sana’s rug. “Today!” she whispered. Today felt special. Usually Sana watched stars late. But this morning a puzzle tickled her brain. Sparky, her dragon puppet, looked droopy. His scales lost their sparkle. His eyes were dim. Sparky needed happy energy. He needed his sparkle back.

“Fizz! Uncle Dee!” Sana called. Fizz the fox zipped in, tail wagging like a happy pendulum. Pat-pat-pat went his paws. Uncle Dee followed, spectacles glinting like tiny suns.

“What’s the matter, little star-gazer?” Uncle Dee asked gently.

“Sparky!” Sana pointed. “He’s not sparky! He needs happy energy. How do I give it to him?” Fizz nudged Sparky. The dragon puppet sighed a quiet puff. He was so droopy.

Uncle Dee smiled. He pulled out a colourful chart. Pictures. Bright boxes. “Sparky has a happy meter!” He pointed. “See these boxes? Food, Water, Sleep, Play. When these boxes get filled, Sparky’s meter sparks and shines!” He showed a sleepy dragon picture. “When he’s droopy, one of these might be low.”

Sana’s eyes popped open. “So if he has yummy treats, cool drinks, a long nap, and fun playtime, he’ll feel better? His meter will fill up?”

“Precisely!” Uncle Dee beamed. “What does Sparky need first?”

Fizz barked. Woof! He nudged a bowl of crunchy dragon kibble. “Food!”

“Super idea, Fizz!” Sana clapped. She measured Sparky’s favourite kibble. As Sparky nibbled, a little green light blinked on the Food box. Sparky blinked. “Mmm, tasty.”

“Now what?” Fizz bounced.

“Water!” Sana remembered Sparky’s sippy cup. She poured cool clear water. Click! A cool blue light glowed on the Water box. Sparky made a happy rumble.

“He’s getting better!” Sana cheered. “But he still looks sleepy.”

“Because he needs sleep!” Fizz chirped. He did a playful somersault. “And after sleep… play!”

Uncle Dee chuckled. “You’ve got it! Let’s give him a cozy blanket for a nap.” They tucked Sparky into soft blankets. As he dozed, the Sleep box lit up yellow. Sparky’s tail gave a happy twitch.

“Just one more thing!” Sana declared. “Playtime!” She bounced Sparky gently. Fizz danced all around him. With each bounce and giggle, the Play box flashed bright orange.

Suddenly Sparky sat up. His scales shimmered like stars. His eyes sparkled. His happy meter was full. Colourful lights burst on the chart. Sparky let out a bright happy roar. “Roar-some!”

“Wow!” Fizz yipped. “He’s sparkly again! He’s back to his best!”

Sana grinned at the full meter, the sparkly Sparky, and Fizz’s blur of a tail. “It’s like a puzzle!” she giggled. “When we gave Sparky what he needed, his meter filled up and he felt great!”

Uncle Dee nodded. Just like Sparky, they needed good food for energy, fresh water, enough sleep, and fun play. Taking care of their needs helped their own meters shine.

Sana’s eyes sparkled. “So eat healthy snacks, drink water, take naps, and play lots!”

She looked at Fizz, already wiggling. With a happy look, they both zipped out, ready for whatever wonderful adventures the day held, with Sparky’s sparkle riding along.
characters: Sana (an early star gazer), Fizz (a pendulum-tailed fox), Dee (a glinting-spectacled uncle)
